introduction: CLASI provides free civil legal help to eligible Delaware residents. Start with the office serving your county.
description: CLASI provides free civil legal help to eligible Delaware residents. Start with the office serving your county.

sections.who: CLASI serves qualifying low-income residents, older adults, people with disabilities and other specified groups. It accepts only issues within its practice areas and resources.
sections.get: Help can concern housing, benefits, family, domestic violence or other civil matters. Criminal and personal-injury cases are excluded.

sections.apply:
1. Call the county office

    New Castle: 302-575-0660; Kent: 302-674-8500; Sussex: 302-856-0038. See CLASI Legal Services.

  2. Complete intake

    Staff collect basic information. If eligible, legal staff review the issue and contact you.

  3. Ask about alternatives

    If CLASI cannot assist, ask about another provider or use Delaware Legal Help Link.
sections.after: Clarify whether representation has been accepted. Keep your own deadline calendar while waiting.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CLASI eligibility and intake; CLASI program overview. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
